changelog.summary: Adds a reviewed booking-link delivery route, provider-confirmed send and booked-meeting contracts, and explicit connector setup.
Adds a chat-led inbound sales proposal with two required Crews, optional account research, validated draft handoffs, and a manual first run.

title: Inbound Lead-to-Meeting Review
description: Qualify inbound enquiries, offer a reviewed booking path, and track provider-confirmed delivery and meetings.
setup_prompt: Use this Playbook as a chat-led proposal. Inspect the current Automation, existing Crews, website lead source, CRM, email and calendar connections, routing policy, suppression, and previous contact. Propose one bounded form-to-meeting route: offer direct booking only where a verified website booking integration exists; otherwise prepare a reviewed booking-link reply, send only through an explicitly authorized channel, and reconcile the provider-confirmed meeting. Show exact steps, connection scopes, approval and deduplication gates, and a manual test. After I review the concrete proposal, configure it through Builder chat tools and verify the actual route. Selecting the Playbook alone does not create Crews, send, write CRM, publish a widget, or activate recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized inbound lead source or export
Offer, target buyer, fit and routing criteria
Lead owner and review decision maker
Contact, suppression, approval, and duplicate rules
Useful meeting definition, source, and baseline decision
Manual-only or reviewed cadence and timezone
Verified booking URL or website booking provider and calendar outcome source

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing sales specialist with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass only a validated bounded lead or research artifact to the next authorized Crew

recommended_tools.name: CRM or form export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current inbound requests, owner and prior-contact state from an authorized source

recommended_tools.name: CRM, email, or calendar connection
recommended_tools.purpose: Support separately approved delivery and actual meeting outcome tracking

recommended_tools.name: Builder workflow webhook
recommended_tools.purpose: Accept authorized form events asynchronously with signature and event ID checks

recommended_tools.name: Google Workspace connection
recommended_tools.purpose: Read Gmail and Calendar, and send a reviewed reply only when agent-write scope is explicitly granted

pulse_focus.label: Qualified conversations
focus_areas: Whether reviewed follow-ups address the buyer's actual request
Whether qualified leads become useful meetings without duplicate or blocked contact
review_when: Qualification policy changes, a lead replies, a meeting is booked, or source freshness fails

outputs: Reviewed sales Crew roster and source map
Owner-reviewed follow-up draft and action ledger
Manual route evidence and meeting-measurement policy
Provider-confirmed delivery receipt when a message is actually sent
Calendar or CRM confirmed meeting outcome when booked
